deviations.change: The shared inset reserves a mobile block-start lane while retaining the pinned desktop layout.
deviations.reason: The factory-added fixed mobile sidebar trigger otherwise overlaps the visible page heading at 320 px; the shared shell boundary must provide clearance without changing individual pages.
deviations.evidence: The paired 320 px reference/generated geometry assertion proves the Contacts heading begins at or below the trigger bottom edge, and the desktop data-grid interaction regression preserves the desktop layout.
evidenceChecks: tests/e2e/saas-ui-golden.visual.spec.ts#keeps page headings clear of the sidebar trigger

deviations.change: The upstream Resizer is mounted through ClientOnly and its fallback renders the sidebar child during SSR; the resizer attaches after hydration.
deviations.reason: The pinned upstream hook evaluates the browser-only document global during render, causing generated TanStack Start SSR to throw ReferenceError: document is not defined.
deviations.evidence: Generated-target SSR reproduced the error in @saas-ui-pro/react useResize while rendering AppSidebar; client-resizer.test.tsx renders the fallback with renderToString without throwing.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/features/common/components/client-resizer.test.tsx#renders its fallback during SSR without evaluating the browser-only resizer

deviations.change: The resize handle receives role=separator and aria-orientation=vertical alongside its existing accessible label.
deviations.reason: The upstream component renders a div; aria-label on that div is prohibited without a valid role.
deviations.evidence: Paired axe run reported serious aria-prohibited-attr on .sui-resize-handle; shell.test.tsx asserts the generated sidebar source includes the separator role and orientation.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/features/common/shell.test.tsx#guards the upstream resizer from SSR and exposes an accessible separator

deviations.change: The generated web target sets exactOptionalPropertyTypes to false.
deviations.reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source currently relies on optional component props that are not assignable under the repository-wide exact optional property contract.
deviations.evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true after the production build produces 34 web type errors (28 TS2375 and 6 TS2379), primarily optional component props receiving undefined; the relaxed override remains required.
evidenceChecks: tooling/generators/src/blueprints/saasFrontendGeneratedTarget.test.ts#builds a freshly materialized customer target with frozen dependencies

deviations.change: The generated web target sets noUncheckedIndexedAccess to false.
deviations.reason: The transplanted Starter/Saas UI source indexes registry and fixture collections without handling undefined values under the repository-wide indexed-access contract.
deviations.evidence: At generated-target proof commit acbced929, enabling noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true after the production build produces 13 web type errors (8 TS18048, 1 TS2322, 2 TS2345, and 2 TS2532), from unchecked collection/indexed values; the relaxed override remains required.
evidenceChecks: tooling/generators/src/blueprints/saasFrontendGeneratedTarget.test.ts#builds a freshly materialized customer target with frozen dependencies

deviations.change: The upstream Stat.Root and Stat.Label for the chart/legend block render as div elements while retaining the upstream Stat styles and layout props.
deviations.reason: Chakra Stat.Root defaults to dl, but this block contains a chart div and legend ul rather than a dt/dd pair; the default markup triggers axe definition-list serious violations.
deviations.evidence: The pinned desktop authority artifact and generated desktop authority artifact both reported axe rule definition-list (serious) on <dl class="chakra-stat__root css-1pbhjgj"> with direct chart div and legend ul children; focused generated axe passed after the seam, and the pinned reference source was synchronized with the same minimal semantic change.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/features/reports/reports-page.test.tsx#does not expose the chart legend as an invalid definition-list item

deviations.change: The factory provider composition supplies the generated QueryClient and fake-safe AuthProvider around the preserved Saas UI provider.
deviations.reason: The pinned Starter provider imports starter-owned auth and query clients; the factory must close those providers at the neutral adapter boundary so generated SSR and browser fixtures render without starter credentials.
deviations.evidence: app-provider.test.tsx verifies the provider composition with a real QueryClient and the reference authority launcher reaches Vite preview after the provider seam.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/features/common/providers/app-provider.test.tsx#closes the generated auth and React Query provider boundary

deviations.change: The browser-only upstream Resizer is replaced at both served factory call sites by the shared ClientResizer seam while preserving the upstream layout and resize-handle structure.
deviations.reason: The upstream Resizer evaluates browser globals during SSR; ClientResizer defers that behavior behind ClientOnly for generated TanStack Start SSR.
deviations.evidence: The receipt-backed adapted-file test hashes both served call sites, and the existing client-resizer SSR evidence covers renderToString without a document global.
evidenceChecks: tooling/generators/src/blueprints/saasFrontendGeneratedTarget.test.ts#projects SSR-safe provider and resizer seams for upstream screens

deviations.change: The root route passes its route-context QueryClient into the adapted AppProvider.
deviations.reason: The factory provider seam requires the route-owned query client while preserving the upstream root document and shell composition.
deviations.evidence: The generated-target SSR provider test exercises the root composition and the reference authority launcher reaches preview startup.
evidenceChecks: tooling/generators/src/blueprints/saasFrontendGeneratedTarget.test.ts#projects SSR-safe provider and resizer seams for upstream screens

deviations.change: The starter tRPC client is represented by a neutral recursive fake facade until generated refs replace it.
deviations.reason: Starter-specific tRPC credentials and client construction are not available in the factory; the facade keeps transplanted screens runnable with fake fixtures.
deviations.evidence: react.test.tsx verifies nested query/mutation access remains fake-safe, and the generated-target proof reaches the web build without a live tRPC client.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/lib/trpc/react.test.tsx#serves the shared neutral fixtures required by projected SaaS UI screens

deviations.change: The preserved aside gains named open/close controls and restores focus to its trigger after close or Escape.
deviations.reason: The upstream Aside primitive exposes controlled open state but no close control or trigger relationship; the acceptance contract requires keyboard-close and focus restoration.
deviations.evidence: The paired golden interaction spec closes the contact details aside with Escape and asserts focus returns to the named trigger.

deviations.change: The upstream DataGrid is mounted through ClientOnly while retaining its original client-side JSX and styles.
deviations.reason: The column-resizer EnvironmentContext evaluates document during SSR, which crashes both reference and generated golden authorities.
deviations.evidence: data-grid.ssr.test.tsx reproduces ReferenceError: document is not defined for the vendor DataGrid with resizing enabled; the ContactsListPage SSR regression and paired desktop golden subset prove the boundary and hydrated grid.
evidenceChecks: apps/web/src/features/contacts/list/list-page.ssr.test.tsx#renders the data-grid route during SSR without browser globals

deviations.change: Sortable grid headers retain their interactive title while aria-sort moves to the native column header, decorative sort icons are hidden from assistive technology, and contact action menus receive a name.
deviations.reason: The pinned package writes aria-sort to a div and aria-label to a presentational span, while the preserved contact list creates unnamed icon-only action triggers; both are serious or critical WCAG failures.
deviations.evidence: The paired data-grid accessibility test fails on both authorities before the seam; frozen generated-target installation includes the patch, and paired axe coverage verifies the repaired DOM without rule exclusions.
evidenceChecks: tests/e2e/saas-ui-golden.accessibility.spec.ts#test(`${kind} keeps sorting semantics on column headers and names row actions`, async ({

deviations.change: The login password field identifies a current credential to browsers, and the text-bearing billing action retains its native button role.
deviations.reason: The preserved screens used invalid autocomplete="password" and overrode a named button to role=group, producing serious and critical WCAG failures.
deviations.evidence: Focused paired axe coverage passes both auth and billing routes on the reference and generated authorities without rule exclusions.
evidenceChecks: tests/e2e/saas-ui-golden.accessibility.spec.ts#test(`${entry.id} ${kind} has no serious or critical axe violations`, async ({

deviations.change: The non-interactive visual dots are represented as one named progressbar with hidden decorative dots and step value 1–4.
deviations.reason: The upstream dots recipe exposes a tablist whose direct wrapper children are not tabs, and hides the only tab titles; progression is form-driven, so it must not promise tab keyboard behavior.
deviations.evidence: Paired reference/generated regression asserts the named progressbar, current value, and absence of a tablist.

deviations.evidence: Paired onboarding dark-mode accessibility coverage executes the validation flow on reference and generated authorities; the dark token remains red.300 and the route has no serious or critical axe violations.
